thread_text:
Alejandra: FYI Pineacre reported a p99 jump on embeddings after last night's quantization rollout. Customer saw ~2-3x tail increase, started ~2026-03-16 20:30 UTC. sample req ids: req_8f3a, req_8f3b.

Tom: any obvious routing changes or capacity shifts for their tenant/shard?

Priya: looking at deploy history — quantize-3 rolled to model-c-2 in us-east-1 at 2026-03-16T20:12Z. I see queue_depth spike on shard-g around 20:28 and a rise in preemption events. attaching quick metric excerpt below.

InfraBot: Deploy event: quantize-3 -> model-c-2 (us-east-1) completed @ 2026-03-16T20:12:07Z.

Alejandra: repro logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-16T20:28:43Z] req=req_8f3a model=model-c-2 seq=512 p99=1210ms queue=48
[2026-03-16T20:28:44Z] req=req_8f3b model=model-c-2 seq=256 p99=980ms queue=46
```

Tom: ok. quick mitigation options: 1) add Pineacre to a short reservation (priority lane) 2) add tenant to an allowlist so their requests bypass aggressive batching/queueing 3) rollback quantize-3 on model-c-2 for that shard. Fastest = reservation/allowlist.

Priya: agreed. I can do a short reservation + routing weight change. command to create reservation: `redwoodctl reservations create --tenant pineacre --size 2gpus --ttl 2h` then pin routing: `redwoodctl routing set-weight --tenant pineacre --shard shard-g --weight 0.9`

EngOncall: I'll stand up the reservation and patch routing. executing now.

InfraBot: Executing: `redwoodctl reservations create --tenant pineacre --size 2gpus --ttl 2h`
InfraBot: Reservation created: res_991 (expires 2026-03-16T22:45Z).
InfraBot: Executing: `redwoodctl routing set-weight --tenant pineacre --shard shard-g --weight 0.9`
InfraBot: Routing update applied.

Tom: Also toggled a temporary throttle bypass flag for Pineacre so they don't get grouped into the long batching window: `tenant.flags.set pineacre batch_window_override=50ms`

Alejandra: customer confirms reduced tail in their latest test: p99 ~180ms now (just reported). They said their production traffic looks back to normal for the last 3 probes. :relieved:

Priya: great. follow-ups: 1) file a short postmortem with root cause (quantize-3 kernel changed latency characteristics under certain seq distributions) 2) add an eval to catch p99 regressions for embeddings after quantization rollouts 3) consider adding per-tenant pre-deploy smoke for high-SLA customers.

EngOncall: created incident ticket INC-4721 to track postmortem and monitoring alerts. Leaving the reservation for 2h and then we can reassess.

Tom: notes for handoff -> Operations: if we see similar p99 spikes after future quantize rollouts, prefer ephemeral reservation + routing weight change over rollback to avoid churn. Also add a canary with the same seq distribution as Pineacre.

Alejandra: thanks team — I'll update the customer thread and ask them to keep an eye on the next 24h. Closing here unless we see a reoccurence.

Priya: opening a GH issue to add the eval + a short runbook for priority-lane creation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/issues/128

EngOncall: marking this thread resolved in support channel.
